title: rubus hirtus var. spinifer
intro: Rubus hirtus var. spinifer, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan strawberry, is a plant species in the Rubus genus, characterized by its prickly canes and edible fruit. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory health benefits, and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rubus hirtus var. spinifer include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which help to prevent infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
